# Measured by hand for PRB-1916 on 2026-11-19: the links a composition from the finals without the compositions (PRB-1914) writes on the Synodal's words that today's final leaves bare, the two New Testament pairs read together (seeds 1914, 1916, 19162 on scratch store DSP-1000). Each combination below was measured at 90% on the pair's statements, the Strong pairings, but a word a composition writes on is one no statement answers: a word whose number names nothing in the verse (a reading the edition lacks, a verse divided elsewhere) or one with no number (a conjunction, pronoun or preposition), where the statements' measure does not hold. Right = the Russian word renders that Greek word; a pronoun on the verb whose person it renders is right. What all three readings found (as written and as stems and through kjv) read 19 of 20 right on such words, and the stems with the King James 6 of 6: they keep their measured floors.
